answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose to generate synthetic data in a cross-lingual fashion, borrowing the idea from monolingual QA research efforts. On English corpora, generating synthetic questions has shown to significantly improve the performance of QA models.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic questions in multiple languages for cross-lingual question answering

answer_2.quote: In Table 2 we report the BLEU-4 scores for QG synth+trans grouped by the language of the question.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a manual qualitative analysis on a small number of samples. Note that the annotators need to have a professional level in the language of the generated question to evaluate its fluency, and to be bilingual, when evaluating its relevance w.r.t. input context in our cross language scenario.
answer_4.guideline: evaluating its fluency, and to be bilingual, when evaluating its relevance w.r.t. input context
